observations: Skipped priority-1 seed fabro-af22 this lap: its fix lives in external pinned dep pebble-coding-agent (lithoscomputer/pebble, rev-pinned in Cargo.toml) via open upstream PR fabro-sh/fabro#784, and the seed's own close condition is that PR merging plus a denkhaus merge — not implementable in this tree until then. It will keep surfacing as top candidate every lap; consider unassigning from fabro or blocking it until upstream lands.

Seed fabro-7028's 'verified by one forced gate-red bounce' acceptance is not reproducible inside a normal run (forcing a red gate wastes a cycle); substituted grep-level verification plus absence of the fidelity warn in the next red-bounce run as the practical check.

The live engine warn ('preamble_allow_keys entry absent from context') fired for several runs before anyone connected it to the node-id-derived output key — a lint-time cross-check between context_allow_keys declarations and command-node ids in workflow.fabro would have caught fabro-7028's mismatch at authoring time instead of after live runs.

Verified a churn-only rename seed purely from the loop-work diff: all four acceptance criteria (two allow-key renames, three comment syncs, no collateral renames) map 1:1 onto visible hunks in workflow.fabro; schema/script names correctly left alone since the context key derives from the node id via output_key(&node.id). fs_hide prevented independent re-read of workflow.fabro with file tools, but the capture was complete and internally consistent (counts match hunks, clean worktree), so no re-read was needed.
